name: Supernova BYKX field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward BYKX, a distant Type Ia supernova found by Subaru, seen by Hubble.
label: supernovabykxfield-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field is BYKX, a far-off exploding star caught by the Subaru telescope's supernova search. Hubble followed it in infrared light to help measure how dark energy shapes the expansion of the universe.

claims.text: BYKX is a Type Ia supernova target of program 15363
Program 15363 (SUSHI) follows supernovae discovered by Subaru's Hyper Suprime-Cam search
The program aims to improve dark energy measurements
